tk.intro: That thought that doesn’t belong in a meeting belongs here. Share it anonymously, pick your favourite and let the department decide.
tk.artQuote: This meeting could have been a tontakery.
tk.rule1: One post per round. Winners of the previous round get two chances.
tk.rule2: Pick someone else’s post. You can change your vote until closing time.
tk.rule3: At 09:00 Madrid time we reveal the winners. Ties share the glory.
tk.emptyBody: No posts yet. The first great tontakery could be yours.
tk.usedAll: You’ve left your mark. Keep reading and cast your vote.
tk.noWinner: No winner this round. No votes were cast.
tk.firstRound: The first winner is yet to come. See you at nine.
tk.privacy: Votes are private. Only winning authors are revealed.
tk.historyIntro: The posts that won over the department. Dates show when each round closed.
tk.footer: A little humour between all that work.
tk.confirmBody: Once published, you cannot edit or delete it. It will count towards your posts for this round.
